text:
incident-bot: PAGER — Dedicated pool dp-aurorapeak hitting GPU capacity exhaustion (100% GPU util across all nodes) for 2m; latency increased, some 429s. Paging oncall.

sam.sre: On it. Pulling logs & queue depth now. tagging lucas.ops and maria.engineer.

maria.engineer: metrics: queue length spiked from 20->320, tail p95 latency for /v1/generate at 4.2s -> 18s. Memory fine, but KV cache pressure high.

lucas.ops: autoscale policy for dp-aurorapeak is off (tenant pinned). No spare capacity in that zone. We have a reserved burst pool spare-burst-1 in us-west2 with 4 gpus. Can manual-burst 2 GPUs for 15m. Risk: could cause contention for other dedicated pools if we reassign nodes.

carla.support: Customer (AuroraPeak) reports degraded inference for critical endpoint, some requests timing out. They're escalating with their SREs. Need ETA and mitigation asap.

patrick.pm: If we burst, get committed timeline and tell customer: 15m burst + temporary throttling. Also consider enabling tenant-specific rate limit if we force burst.

jessica-oncall: +1 to manual burst, but prefer short-term traffic shaping first. Can we set a soft throttling rule: limit concurrent requests for 'generation-large' model to 40% of normal for this tenant?

maria.engineer: Yes, we can push a per-tenant rate limit in the edge router: `rbac update-tenant aurorapeak --concurrency 40%` — will take ~2m to propagate.

lucas.ops: If throttling doesn't bring down queue we should run manual burst. Command ready: ```
redwoodctl pool burst --pool dp-aurorapeak --from spare-burst-1 --gpus 2 --duration 15m
```

sam.sre: I'll apply throttling now and watch. If after 90s queue > 200, execute burst.

incident-bot: STATUS update: throttling rule applied by sam.sre at 6226543320.

carla.support: Informing customer: ETA initial mitigation in 2m, will update if we need burst. Sending note now.

patrick.pm: Also flagging ops to prioritize follow-up: enable autoscale-on-burst for enterprise pools or add soft-burst quota for this tenant. Create RFC?

jessica-oncall: sam.sre — after burst, we should evict any <priority:low> jobs in pool for 10m to free cache pressure. Approve?

sam.sre: Approved. lucas.ops please prepare eviction plan `evict --pool dp-aurorapeak --priority low --deadline 10m` ready to run if burst needed.

lucas.ops: Plan staged.

maria.engineer: Observability: p95 down from 18s -> 7.5s after throttling, queue dropped to 110. Looks promising.

sam.sre: holding. Not bursting.

carla.support: Customer acknowledges throttling message, appreciates transparency. They reported errors reduced.

incident-bot: METRIC update at 6226543550: queue=82 p95=5.1s GPU util=78%.

jessica-oncall: Good. cancel burst plan. I'll coordinate eviction cancel and rollback rate limit to 70% in 10m.

sam.sre: rolling back to 70% now.

patrick.pm: Follow-ups: (1) ops to add a 2-GPU soft-burst quota for Aurorapeak, (2) product to propose tenant autoscale enablement for enterprise pools, (3) support to draft post-incident customer note.

lucas.ops: Logged task infra#4321 for soft-burst quota + infra#4322 for autoscale eval.

incident-bot: INCIDENT resolved — monitoring for 30m. Notified oncall rotation. :white_check_mark:
